svg.title: The Hot Rocks Sauna and Lough Neagh
svg.desc: Regional map locating The Hot Rocks Sauna at Gawley’s Gate on the south-east shore of Lough Neagh, west of Belfast and Lisburn and north of Lurgan. An aircraft icon marks Belfast International Airport, south of Antrim. Map data from OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL) and Natural Earth.
